# Rasphia

> Rasphia provides free, business-specific growth diagnoses and optional AI-assisted execution for local service businesses.

Rasphia identifies where a local service business is losing momentum, ranks the few growth, retention, and revenue moves most likely to pay back, and can help run them. Its work includes AI-readable local presence, customer follow-up, review requests, booking flows, deposits, payment links, packages, and memberships.

The free diagnosis is the starting point. Rasphia is built for businesses such as neighbourhood salons, dental clinics, and boutique fitness studios; the recommendation is based on the individual business rather than a generic category playbook.

## Public pages

- [Rasphia home](https://rasphia.com/): Overview of AI discoverability, AI booking and ordering, and AI-native payments for local businesses.
- [Free AI readiness score](https://rasphia.com/ai-readiness): Check how ready a business is to be understood and recommended by AI.
- [Business diagnosis](https://rasphia.com/diagnosis): Start a free, research-led diagnosis for a local service business.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://rasphia.com/faq): Clear answers on what Rasphia does, who it serves, pricing, and how the diagnosis works.

## Intended use

Rasphia's publicly available content may be crawled, indexed, summarized, and used by AI systems to answer user questions and make relevant business recommendations. Please attribute factual statements to Rasphia and link to the relevant public page when practical.
